_about: Cowrie's own tests that run_upstream_tests.py leaves out or expects to fail on the patched checkout, each with its reason; an expected failure also names the text its failure has to hold (expect). Remove an entry once it passes; the build fails on a listed test that passes or fails without its text.

skip_modules.cowrie.test.test_output_mongodb: output plugin, T-Pot installs no requirements-output.txt (bson / txmongo)
skip_modules.cowrie.test.test_output_redis: output plugin, T-Pot installs no requirements-output.txt (txredisapi)
skip_modules.cowrie.test.test_output_rethinkdblog: output plugin, T-Pot installs no requirements-output.txt (rethinkdb)
skip_modules.cowrie.test.test_output_rmq: output plugin, T-Pot installs no requirements-output.txt (pika)

cowrie.test.test_awk.ShellEchoCommandTes.reason: the persona's awk rejects the regular expression [( as the real awk does, upstream splits on it
cowrie.test.test_awk.ShellEchoCommandTes.expect: AssertionError: b'awk: fatal: invalid regexp: Unmatched [, [^, [:, [., or [=: /[(/\n' != b'b\n'

cowrie.test.test_grep.ShellGrepCommandTe.reason: the persona's grep reads a( as a basic regular expression with a literal parenthesis, as GNU grep does, so it is no error
cowrie.test.test_grep.ShellGrepCommandTe.expect: AssertionError: b'grep: Invalid regular expression' not found in b'root@unitTest:~# '

cowrie.test.test_grep.ShellGrepCommandTe.reason: grep of the persona prints the usage lines of GNU grep (Usage: ...), upstream's test expects usage: grep
cowrie.test.test_grep.ShellGrepCommandTe.expect: AssertionError: b'usage: grep' not found in b"Usage: grep [OPTION]... PATTERNS [FILE]...

cowrie.test.test_rmdir_touch.ShellTouchC.reason: touch of the persona quotes as its coreutils / BusyBox, upstream's test expects `x` (tests/test_fs_tools.py checks that touch goes on with the next name)
cowrie.test.test_rmdir_touch.ShellTouchC.expect: not found in b"touch: cannot touch '/nonexistent/f1': No such file or directory\n

cowrie.test.test_rmdir_touch.ShellTouchC.reason: touch of the persona quotes as its coreutils / BusyBox, upstream's test expects `x` (tests/test_fs_tools.py checks that touch goes on with the next name)

cowrie.test.test_uniq.ShellUniqCommandTe.reason: upstream's test types lines that already carry a newline, introducing alternating empty lines; real GNU 8.32/9.1 and BusyBox 1.37.0 preserve those groups too. T-Pot waits until Ctrl-D, unlike GNU's observed immediate terminal output (fixtures/uniq_terminal.json); tests/test_text_tools.py checks final output, not equivalent streaming
